text:
SY324
Sociology of Food and Culture
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
The
course
addresses structural and symbolic aspects of the contemporary foodscapes in North America, with a focus on the Canadian context. Food matters are examined as social justice concerns and modes of cultural communication. Theoretical approaches employed may include feminist, queer family studies, cultural studies and critical race.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY207
(or SY203*).
Exclusions
SY309D.
